question:
Refer to the exhibit. A network administrator experiences these issues with the network:
- PC1 is experiencing a buffering problem for video applications.
- The servers that are connected to SW2 are experiencing packet drops when they connect to the internet.
The engineer wants to configure the required traffic capture to investigate the issue further.
Which configuration must be implemented to monitor the traffic?
context: Topology: Monitoring Device -Eth2/3- N9K -Eth1/1- SW1 (PC1 Vlan10, PC2 Vlan15); N9K -Eth1/2- SW2 (Vlan18-23 servers).
imageNote: Diagram: Monitoring Device connects through a LAN Network cloud to N9K (Eth2/3), which connects via Eth1/1 to SW1 and Eth1/2 to SW2; SW1 links to PC1 (Vlan10) and PC2 (Vlan15); SW2 links to two servers (Vlan 18-23).
options:
N9K(config)# monitor session 5 tx
N9K(config-monitor)# description Span_session_5
N9K(config-monitor)# source vlan 10-15 rx
N9K(config-monitor)# source interface ethernet 1/2
N9K(config-monitor)# destination interface ethernet 2/3

N9K(config)# monitor session 5 rx
N9K(config)# monitor session 5 tx
N9K(config-monitor)# description Span_session_5
N9K(config-monitor)# source interface ethernet 1/1
N9K(config-monitor)# source interface ethernet 1/2
N9K(config-monitor)# destination interface ethernet 2/3

N9K(config)# monitor session 5 tx
N9K(config-monitor)# description Span_session_5
N9K(config-monitor)# source interface ethernet 1/1
N9K(config-monitor)# source interface ethernet 1/2
N9K(config-monitor)# destination interface ethernet 2/3

N9K(config)# monitor session 5 rx
N9K(config-monitor)# description Span_session_5
N9K(config-monitor)# source vlan 10 rx
N9K(config-monitor)# source interface ethernet 1/2
N9K(config-monitor)# destination interface ethernet 2/3
theory: An NX-OS SPAN session mirrors traffic from one or more sources — physical interfaces, port channels, or entire VLANs — to a single destination interface connected to an analyzer, and each source can be scoped to only ingress (rx), only egress (tx), or left as both by default. Because the two reported symptoms trace back to different traffic paths through the switch (client traffic on Eth1/1 and server-to-internet traffic on Eth1/2), the session needs both uplink interfaces added as tx sources so the switch's own outbound traffic toward each segment is captured, all mirrored to the dedicated SPAN destination on Ethernet 2/3 — mixing in a VLAN-only source or a single-interface source, as the other options do, would miss traffic relevant to one of the two reported problems. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 6 — SPAN Session Sources, Destinations, and Direction)
